name: Zabbix
description: Gives AI clients the current problems and the hosts of a Zabbix server (6.4 or later) together with the Phoedox entry each host belongs to (matched by host name, visible name, IP address or DNS name). Read-only, no import. Settings: url (the Zabbix frontend, e.g. https://zabbix.example.org; the plugin calls /api_jsonrpc.php below it) and token (an API token of a user whose role may read the hosts and problems in question; no write access needed). The plugin reads the knowledge graph only to find matching entries.

mcpTools.name: zabbix.problems
mcpTools.description: The 100 most recent problems (including recently resolved ones): name, severity, acknowledged, since when, hosts and the matching Phoedox entry.

mcpTools.name: zabbix.hosts
mcpTools.description: Hosts with technical and visible name, status (enabled or disabled), availability, IP address, DNS name and the matching Phoedox entry.
